items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s where I think I heard Cecil Taylor for the first time, playing a duo with a trumpeter named Clifford Jarvis.

ctx.x: I think. There was Cafe Wha, Cafe Bizarre. That’s where I think I heard Cecil Taylor for the first time, playing a duo with a trumpeter named Clifford Jarvis. It was incredible. All these clubs. Uptown, Club Baron, Small’s. There was a chicken and waffles place, uh . . . .
